description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class 'SugarFieldTextTest' for testing the 'SugarFieldText' class. The tests verify the correct setup and error handling of TinyMCE editor initialization within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform, including handling of exceptions, configuration, and contextual execution based on request parameters.

classes.name: SugarFieldTextTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SugarFieldText, testing TinyMCE initialization and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating a new instance of SugarFieldText.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test, unsetting $_REQUEST['action'] if set.

methods.name: testSetupHandlesTinyMCEInitializationError
methods.description: Tests error handling when TinyMCE configuration throws an exception, ensuring error logging occurs and TinyMCE is not loaded.

methods.name: testSetupWithValidHTMLEditor
methods.description: Verifies that TinyMCE is properly initialized when 'editor' is 'html' and configuration succeeds.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutHTMLEditor
methods.description: Ensures TinyMCE is not loaded when 'editor' is not 'html'.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutEditViewAction
methods.description: Checks that the setup method handles absence of 'action' in $_REQUEST gracefully.

methods.name: testSetupWithDifferentAction
methods.description: Verifies TinyMCE is not loaded when the request 'action' is not 'EditView'.

methods.name: testSetupWithFormNameGeneratesCorrectSelector
methods.description: Tests that the TinyMCE selector string is correctly formatted with a given formName.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutFormNameGeneratesCorrectSelector
methods.description: Tests that the TinyMCE selector string is correct when no formName is provided.

methods.name: testSetupIncludesHeightOverride
methods.description: Verifies that the TinyMCE configuration includes a height setting.

methods.name: testSetupLogsInfoWhenLoadingHTMLEditor
methods.description: Checks that an info log is generated when loading the HTML editor.
